# WO-276 Part F: the shared rules, role by role

<!-- Generated by docs/evidence/WO-276/part-f/rule-table.mjs from the rule records of packages/skeleton/src/loadouts/contributor.ts and the reasons that script holds; edit a reason there and run it. -->

The 33 shared rules of the role roots, in the order a root holds them, each with the reason every role keeps it or is left without it. The roles are the six a record can name; the router's root is written whole and is no composition of these. A role keeps a rule when its procedure reaches the command, the phase or the host the rule governs, or can be configured to; a rule a role keeps is whole in its root, once. The cells that leave a role out: `operator-controls` (release-close), `expected-data` (release-close), `expected-data` (refuter), `amend-order` (release-close), `fan-out` (release-close), `area-notes` (release-close), `area-notes` (planner), `area-notes` (refuter), `initiative-layout` (executor), `initiative-layout` (verifier), `initiative-layout` (reviewer), `initiative-layout` (release-close), `initiative-layout` (refuter), `standing-file` (verifier), `standing-file` (reviewer), `standing-file` (release-close), `standing-file` (planner), `standing-file` (refuter), `worker-launch` (release-close), `bounded-probes` (refuter), `prune-own` (refuter).
